privacy-policy.contentText: 01 / Who we are FREN Inc. is a design studio in Richmond Hill, Georgia. We create brands, environments, original content and interactive experiences. This policy covers our website, inquiries and business relationships with clients, prospective clients, suppliers and collaborators. When we process personal information on a client's behalf, the relevant project agreement and data protection terms also apply. Our work for museums, hospitals and other organizations does not make their websites, applications or visitor records part of this website. 02 / Information we receive Contact details. Your name, email address, organization and other details you choose to provide when you contact us. Project information. Briefs, goals, schedules, budgets, reference materials, attachments and correspondence you share when discussing work. Business records. Billing contacts, invoice details, contracts, approvals and other records needed to manage a professional relationship. Technical information. Website requests send information such as your IP address, requested page and browser details to the hosting service. The service can record this information for delivery, security and troubleshooting. You can provide information through correspondence, meetings, project documents or website features where available. Please share only information relevant to your inquiry or project. 03 / How we use information We use information to respond to inquiries, assess requirements, prepare proposals and deliver design services. We also coordinate feedback, manage invoices and maintain business records. Other purposes include protecting our services, resolving disputes and meeting legal obligations. Technical information supports website delivery, security and improvement. Where we offer newsletters or studio updates, we send them according to your preferences and applicable law. An inquiry does not automatically subscribe you. Where applicable law requires a legal basis, these purposes can involve steps toward a contract, legitimate business interests, legal obligations or consent. You can withdraw consent for processing that relies on it. 04 / Cookies and similar technologies Cookies and similar browser storage can support website functions and remember preferences. Their use depends on the features available on the website. Where optional analytics or embedded services are used, they can collect information about website use. We provide information and choices required by applicable law. You can manage cookies and stored website data through your browser settings. Blocking them can affect some features. Dismissing a notice is not consent to optional tracking. 05 / Sharing and service providers We can share relevant information with providers that support hosting, communications, file storage, accounting and project delivery. Their access is limited to the relevant services. Specialist collaborators and production partners can receive information needed for agreed work, subject to appropriate confidentiality and data protection obligations. We do not sell personal information. We can share information at your direction or with your consent, including introductions to project partners. We can also disclose information to meet a legal obligation, respond to valid legal requests or protect rights and safety. Any disclosure remains subject to applicable law and our contractual duties. FREN is based in the United States. Communications and service providers can involve processing in the United States or other countries with different privacy laws. Applicable transfer requirements still apply. Links to client sites, social networks and email services lead to services with their own privacy policies. 06 / Retention and security We retain personal information for as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described here, including project delivery, contractual records and legal obligations. The appropriate period depends on the record, our relationship and applicable requirements. We delete or anonymize information when it is no longer needed. We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss or misuse. Access is limited according to business needs. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure. Please use an agreed secure channel for sensitive project files. Do not send passwords, payment card details or medical records through general inquiries. 07 / Your choices and rights You can contact us to request access, correction or deletion of your personal information. Depending on your location, you can also have rights to portability, restriction or objection. Send requests to support@freninc.com with the subject “Privacy request.” Describe the information and action involved. Do not include sensitive identity documents in your first message. We can request limited information to verify your identity or authority. Applicable law determines response periods, exceptions and any right to appeal or complain to a privacy regulator. If you receive marketing emails from us, you can use the unsubscribe option or contact us to stop them. Necessary project and administrative messages can continue. 08 / Children and sensitive information This portfolio and business inquiry website is intended for adults who commission or collaborate on design work. It is not a service for children. We do not seek personal information from children under 13 through this website. If a child has provided information, contact us so we can investigate and address it. Our healthcare and education projects can involve special requirements. Do not submit patient information, student records or identifiable research data without an agreed process and appropriate authorization. 09 / Changes and contact We will update the date on this page when the policy changes. For material changes, we will provide further notice or obtain consent where required. FREN Inc.10230 Ford Ave, Suite 202Richmond Hill, GA 31324, United Statessupport@freninc.com Related: Terms of Service

terms-of-service.contentText: 01 / Using this website This website is operated by FREN Inc., a design studio in Richmond Hill, Georgia. These terms cover website use and general principles for engaging our services. By using this website, you agree to these terms to the extent permitted by applicable law. If you do not agree, please stop using it. Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle website information and project inquiries. These terms do not replace rights that the law does not allow us to limit. 02 / Design services and agreements FREN works across brand strategy, visual identity, environmental design, original content, digital media and interactive experiences. Sending an inquiry does not create a client relationship, reserve our availability or authorize work. Project services require a separate written agreement. That agreement defines scope, deliverables, fees, payment, schedules, revisions, approvals, expenses, cancellation and support. It takes priority over these website terms for the project. Estimates and proposals are subject to the assumptions and validity periods stated in them. Services begin according to the agreed authorization and payment arrangements. Clients are responsible for timely information, feedback and approvals. Review copy, specifications and final proofs before authorizing publication, production or installation. Changes to scope, delays in feedback or new requirements can affect fees and delivery dates. Those changes must be handled under the project agreement. Additional work and third-party costs require the approvals specified in the agreement. Payment deadlines, deposits and any cancellation charges must be stated in that agreement. Suspension, cancellation and handover follow the project agreement and applicable law. These website terms do not establish a separate cancellation fee or refund schedule. 03 / Creative work and ownership Website text, artwork, photographs, films, animations, code and designs belong to FREN or their respective rights holders. You can view our work and share links to public pages. Viewing or downloading content does not transfer ownership or grant a commercial license. Except where law permits, obtain permission before reproducing, adapting, distributing or commercially using website content. Do not remove credits or rights notices. Project ownership and licenses are defined in the written project agreement. Concepts, working files, source code and unused proposals are not included unless the agreement says so. Any transfer of rights follows the conditions in that agreement, including any agreed payment requirements. Pre-existing tools and methods remain subject to their existing ownership. Fonts, stock media, software and other third-party materials can have separate licenses. Client names and logos remain the property of their owners. Any right to publish client work in our portfolio is subject to the project agreement, confidentiality obligations and required permissions. 04 / Materials you provide Only share materials you have the right to provide for the proposed purpose. Identify restrictions, required credits and third-party permissions. You retain ownership of your materials. Sharing them permits us to review them and respond to your inquiry. Further use is governed by the project agreement. Before sending confidential information, arrange suitable confidentiality terms and a secure transfer method. A general inquiry does not create a nondisclosure agreement. During a project, each party must handle confidential materials according to the applicable confidentiality agreement and legal obligations. Do not send patient information, student records or other sensitive personal data without an agreed process and appropriate authorization. 05 / Acceptable use Use the website lawfully and respect the rights of others. Do not: Attempt unauthorized access to systems, accounts or information. Introduce malicious code, disrupt the website or overload its infrastructure. Impersonate another person or send fraudulent, abusive or unlawful material. Misrepresent our work as your own or imply an endorsement we have not given. We can restrict access where reasonably needed to address misuse, security risks or legal obligations. 06 / Third-party services The website links to clients, collaborators, social networks and other external services. Their operators control their content, availability and terms. A link or project credit does not grant rights to another organization's materials or establish an endorsement beyond the relationship described. 07 / Accuracy and availability Portfolio examples illustrate particular projects. They do not promise the same outcome, budget or schedule for a future project. We can update website content and correct errors. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or that every item will remain current. To the extent permitted by law, this website is provided “as is” and “as available,” without implied warranties of merchantability, fitness or noninfringement. Design examples are not medical, clinical, legal or engineering advice. Project-specific safety, accessibility and technical requirements must be addressed in the agreed scope. 08 / Responsibility and legal rights To the extent permitted by law, FREN is not responsible for indirect or consequential losses caused by use of this website. This limitation does not exclude liability that applicable law does not allow us to exclude. It does not alter obligations under a signed project agreement. Please contact us about a concern so we can try to resolve it. These terms do not require arbitration or waive your statutory remedies. If a provision cannot be enforced, the remaining provisions continue to apply to the extent permitted by law. 09 / Updates and contact Changes to these terms will appear here with an updated date. Material changes will receive further notice where required by law. Website updates do not amend an existing project agreement. Changes to that agreement follow its own amendment process.
